item: C7 / A-028: the wait-loop back-edge hazard recounted on main and closed as met; the no-deadline wait scan lists no unowned loop to bound
summary: Recount on main 0982a0b1f (CPython 3.13.18), same dis scan as the 2026-10-17 report: 802 loops with an uncovered back-edge (was 792), 21 under a lock-like with (was 36), 15 under a releasing finally (was 26); the rest are held by the reach ratchet, the database classification and the worker-only list (61 tests pass). Scan of loops that wait with no deadline: the only unbounded ones belong to WAL (storage_events), keyword (runner._resume_watch) and by-design waits (file_lock has no fixed timeout by its documented design, data_volume boot wait ends on a quit request, egress_window reaper ends with its window, latency watchdog is cancelled at shutdown). No code changed. Not done: a deadline on file_lock waits (a behaviour change, proposal only).
